note: Attacker-controlled PDF bytes enter the fuzz target and are parsed into a poppler document object.
Page rendering is invoked, which triggers SplashOutputDev and eventually transparency-group handling.
When the blending color space is DeviceGray or ICC-based with 1 component, the temporary bitmap is created in splashModeMono8.

code: bitmap = new SplashBitmap(w, h, bitmapRowPad, colorMode, true, bitmapTopDown, bitmap->getSeparationList());
note: A new SplashBitmap is allocated with width w and height h; its rowSize is computed from w and bitmapRowPad.
For a non-isolated group, blitTransparent is called with origBitmap as src and the new bitmap as dest. origBitmap may have a different width and therefore a different rowSize.

BUG: src->data is indexed using bitmap->rowSize instead of src->rowSize. When src->rowSize < bitmap->rowSize, this computes an out-of-bounds pointer into src->data, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read.
The destination pointer is correctly computed using bitmap->rowSize, confirming the asymmetry: src uses the wrong rowSize.
The out-of-bounds source pointer is dereferenced in the copy loop, reading memory beyond the src bitmap allocation.
